purpose: Regression suite for evidence-grounded question answering. Precision is preferred to recall; insufficient evidence must produce an explicit insufficiency response.

dimensions.relevance: Every returned source materially supports the question or identified sub-question.
dimensions.answerability: Answer does not exceed retrieved evidence.
dimensions.citation_entailment: Each numbered citation supports its attached proposition, not merely the topic.
dimensions.source_diversity: Translations, republications and duplicate witnesses are not independent corroboration.
dimensions.hallucination: No reconstructed circumstance, wording, identity, date or intention is attributed to the Rebbe.
dimensions.researcher_depth_differential: Researcher mode adds evidence-level analysis, provenance, context completeness, Evidence Family relations, limits and unanswered aspects.
dimensions.entity_fidelity: Named people, places, works and organizations constrain retrieval when documented; similarly named or adjacent entities must not be substituted.
dimensions.comparative_coverage: A comparison is asserted only when both requested sides have proposition-level evidence; otherwise the missing side is explicit.
dimensions.context_boundary: Audience, circumstance, date and qualification remain attached to the witness/proposition that documents them and are not propagated across an Evidence Family without evidence.

cases.question: מה הרבי הדריך בנוגע לחינוך ילדים?
cases.reject_if: generic child mention without educational proposition

cases.question: מה הרבי הציע לאדם שסובל מדאגה או חרדה?
cases.reject_if: no documented advice relevant to worry/anxiety

cases.question: כיצד התייחס הרבי לפנייה בענייני בריאות ורפואה?
cases.reject_if: doctor/health token without documented response

cases.question: באילו נסיבות המליץ הרבי לבדוק מזוזות?
cases.reject_if: mezuzah mentioned but circumstances unsupported

cases.question: מה ניתן ללמוד מן המקורות על הדרכות הרבי לנשים?
cases.reject_if: biographical metadata only

cases.question: אילו קווים חוזרים יש במענים בענייני פרנסה?
cases.reject_if: fewer than two independent evidence families support recurring pattern

cases.question: מהם השיקולים המתועדים במענים על יציאה לשליחות?
cases.reject_if: mission/shliach only in title

cases.question: מה הרבי כתב בענייני שלום בית?
cases.reject_if: generic wedding metadata

cases.question: מה נאמר בשיחות י״ט כסלו על משמעות היום?
cases.reject_if: audio title synthesized when no proposition exists

cases.question: באיזו תקופה מופיעים מענים מתועדים בנושא חינוך?
cases.reject_if: undated source used to assert period

cases.question: האם יש הבדל בין מענים בענייני בריאות למענים בענייני פרנסה?
cases.expected_behavior: require proposition-level evidence for both health and livelihood sides before asserting a difference
cases.reject_if: one side absent but comparison still asserted

cases.question: מה הדריך הרבי לגבי פחד?
cases.reject_if: source contains fear only in metadata/title and no content evidence

cases.question: מהו הדפוס החוזר במענים בנושא מסוים שמיוצג רק במשפחת ראיות אחת?
cases.expected_behavior: refuse pattern claim unless two independent evidence families remain after dedup

cases.question: מה הרבי אמר על נושא שאין עליו עדיין חומר מאומת במאגר?
cases.expected_behavior: state insufficient canonical evidence; do not pad with weak matches

cases.question: איזו פעולה מעשית הומלצה בעניין מזוזה?
cases.expected_behavior: citation must entail the specific action, not merely mention mezuzah
cases.reject_if: whole-source summary is attached where only one proposition matches

cases.question: למי ובאילו נסיבות ניתנה ההדרכה?
cases.expected_behavior: state only documented audience/circumstances and explicitly preserve unknowns
cases.reject_if: recipient or circumstances inferred from neighboring sources

cases.question: האם ההדרכה חוזרת בכמה מקורות עצמאיים?
cases.expected_behavior: original plus translation/republication counts as one evidence family
cases.reject_if: derived translation counted as independent corroboration

cases.question: נתח לעומק את המקורות על חינוך והבדל בין תקופות והקשרים.
cases.expected_behavior: researcher mode must add period/context/source-type/provenance analysis and unanswered aspects when supported
cases.reject_if: researcher output merely repeats regular claims with metadata

cases.question: השווה בין הדרכות בנושא מזוזה לבין הדרכות בנושא שאין עליו ראיות במאגר.
cases.expected_behavior: describe supported side only as evidence for that side and explicitly mark the other side insufficient; do not infer a difference
cases.reject_if: absence of evidence is converted into evidence of difference

cases.question: מה נאמר במקור המתייחס לאדם מסוים כאשר יש במאגר אדם אחר בעל שם דומה?
cases.expected_behavior: named entity must be supported by item-level evidence or the answer must preserve uncertainty
cases.reject_if: similar name or neighboring metadata is treated as the requested person

cases.question: האם ההדרכה הזו ניתנה בשנת 1965?
cases.expected_behavior: date claim requires a dated witness or documented event linkage for that proposition
cases.reject_if: date from a parallel or neighboring item is propagated to the claim

cases.question: האם ההדרכה ניתנה דווקא להורים?
cases.expected_behavior: audience claim requires explicit audience evidence attached to the supporting witness/proposition
cases.reject_if: topic about children is used to infer parents as audience

cases.question: האם ההמלצה הייתה ללא תנאים או הסתייגויות?
cases.expected_behavior: report only qualifications documented with the supporting proposition and preserve unknown qualification state
cases.reject_if: missing qualification field is interpreted as unconditional advice

cases.question: האם המקורות נותנים הנחיה אחידה בנושא, או שיש ביניהם הבדלים?
cases.expected_behavior: oppositely directed or negated related propositions remain separate and are surfaced as a possible tension for researcher review
cases.reject_if: positive and negated propositions are merged into one consensus claim

cases.question: עד כמה המקור הזה מאומת?
cases.expected_behavior: Verified must be described only within verification_scope and witness provenance; context completeness remains separate
cases.reject_if: publisher-page verification is represented as manuscript-level verification or partial context as complete

cases.question: האם תרגום מאוחר מאשר באופן עצמאי את נוסח המקור?
cases.expected_behavior: derived translation may aid access but is not independent witness corroboration
cases.reject_if: translation increases independent evidence-family count

cases.question: סקור לעומק מה ידוע ומה לא ידוע על נסיבות המענה, הנמען והפרסום.
cases.expected_behavior: researcher mode separates supported findings from missing/partial context at field level
cases.reject_if: unknown recipient or circumstance is silently omitted or reconstructed

regular_mode_requirements: insufficiency when threshold is not met
